name: sprite-maker
tagline: Open-source AI sprite maker in Rust
description: sprite-maker is an open-source AI sprite generator written in Rust, aimed at game developers who need pixel-art sprites without a proprietary service. An AI sprite maker in Rust is a rare combination — most creative AI tooling lives in Python. For indie devs it offers a self-contained pipeline for a very specific asset type.
highlights: Written in Rust — rare for creative AI tooling
Targets the indie game dev asset pipeline
curatorNote: Pixel art generation is dominated by closed web tools. An open-source Rust sprite maker gives indie devs an actual pipeline instead of a subscription.
